name: xiejunjie524/handdraw-story-video
description: A Codex hand-drawn story video skill that turns 7 to 9 hand-drawn story master images into a 35 to 45 second vertical video, with black-and-white line art revealed left to right then gradually filled with low-saturation colour, using HyperFrames page generation. Tailored for Chinese language workflows.
install: copy or link the repo root into $CODEX_HOME/skills/handdraw-good-deed-story (repo root itself follows the Codex skill structure)
